units.locator: Article 51. Rural settlement elder
units.text: 2) interacts with the population, including through participation in citizens’ assemblies and meetings, and following those events submits appeals and proposals that local self-government bodies must consider;
units.label: Point 2 Part 8 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Rural settlement elder
units.text: 3) informs rural settlement residents about the organization and exercise of local self-government and assists in bringing other information received from local self-government bodies to their attention;
units.label: Point 3 Part 8 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Rural settlement elder
units.text: 4) assists local self-government bodies in organizing and holding public hearings and public discussions and in making their results public in the rural settlement;
units.label: Point 4 Part 8 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Rural settlement elder
units.text: 5) may propose the submission of an initiative project on matters of priority importance to rural settlement residents;
units.label: Point 5 Part 8 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Rural settlement elder
units.text: 6) exercises other powers provided for by a regulatory legal act of the municipal representative body in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 6 Part 8 Art. 51

units.locator: Article 51. Rural settlement elder
units.text: 9. Guarantees for the activities of a rural settlement elder and other matters concerning the elder’s status, including logistical and organizational support, are established by a regulatory legal act of the municipal representative body in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 51

units.locator: Chapter 6. Municipal legal acts
units.text: Chapter 6. Municipal legal acts
units.label: Chapter 6. Municipal legal acts

units.locator: Article 52. System of municipal legal acts, procedure for their preparation and entry into force
units.text: Article 52. System of municipal legal acts, procedure for their preparation and entry into force
units.label: Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. System of municipal legal acts, procedure for their preparation and entry into force
units.text: 1. The system of municipal legal acts includes:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. System of municipal legal acts, procedure for their preparation and entry into force
units.text: 1) legal acts adopted at a local referendum or citizens’ assembly;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. System of municipal legal acts, procedure for their preparation and entry into force
units.text: 2) legal acts of the municipal representative body;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. System of municipal legal acts, procedure for their preparation and entry into force
units.text: 3) legal acts of the head of the municipality;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. System of municipal legal acts, procedure for their preparation and entry into force
units.text: 4) legal acts of the local administration;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. System of municipal legal acts, procedure for their preparation and entry into force
units.text: 5) legal acts of other local self-government bodies and officials provided for by the municipal charter.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. System of municipal legal acts, procedure for their preparation and entry into force
units.text: 2. The municipal charter and decisions adopted at a local referendum or citizens’ assembly and formalized as legal acts have the highest legal force within the system of municipal legal acts, have direct effect and apply throughout the municipality.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. System of municipal legal acts, procedure for their preparation and entry into force
units.text: 3. Other municipal legal acts must not conflict with the municipal charter or legal acts adopted at a local referendum or citizens’ assembly.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. System of municipal legal acts, procedure for their preparation and entry into force
units.text: 4. The procedure for submitting draft municipal legal acts and the list and form of accompanying documents are established by a legal act of the local self-government body or official to whom the drafts are submitted for consideration.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. System of municipal legal acts, procedure for their preparation and entry into force
units.text: 5. Draft municipal legal acts of municipalities containing administrative centers of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and of other municipalities included in the relevant list by a law of the constituent entity under part 7 of this Article, that establish new or amend existing mandatory requirements for persons engaged in entrepreneurial or other economic activity, or obligations for persons engaged in investment activity, are subject to regulatory impact assessment by the local self-government bodies of those municipalities in accordance with the procedure established by municipal legal acts pursuant to a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, except:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. System of municipal legal acts, procedure for their preparation and entry into force
units.text: 1) draft regulatory legal acts of municipal representative bodies establishing, changing, suspending or abolishing local taxes and fees;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. System of municipal legal acts, procedure for their preparation and entry into force
units.text: 2) draft regulatory legal acts of municipal representative bodies regulating budgetary legal relations;
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. System of municipal legal acts, procedure for their preparation and entry into force
units.text: 3) draft regulatory legal acts developed to eliminate natural and technological emergencies for the duration of emergency regimes.
units.label: Point 3 Part 5 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. System of municipal legal acts, procedure for their preparation and entry into force
units.text: 6. Regulatory impact assessment of draft municipal regulatory legal acts is conducted to identify provisions introducing or contributing to the introduction of excessive duties, prohibitions and restrictions on persons engaged in entrepreneurial and other economic activity, and provisions contributing to unjustified expenditure by such persons and local budgets.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. System of municipal legal acts, procedure for their preparation and entry into force
units.text: 7. A law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation establishes the list of municipalities in which regulatory impact assessment is mandatory for draft municipal legal acts establishing new or amending existing mandatory requirements for persons engaged in entrepreneurial and other economic activity, or obligations for persons engaged in investment activity. The law determines the criteria for including urban okrugs and municipal okrugs in that list, reflecting the objective characteristics of local self-government in that constituent entity, including the degree of concentration of state powers assigned to such municipalities.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. System of municipal legal acts, procedure for their preparation and entry into force
units.text: 8. Municipal legal acts enter into force in accordance with the procedure established by the municipal charter, except regulatory legal acts of representative bodies of local self-government on taxes and fees, which enter into force in accordance with the Tax Code of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 52. System of municipal legal acts, procedure for their preparation and entry into force
units.text: 9. Municipal regulatory legal acts affecting human and civil rights, freedoms and duties, municipal regulatory legal acts establishing the legal status of organizations founded by the municipality, and agreements concluded between local self-government bodies enter into force after their official publication.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 52

units.locator: Article 53. Making municipal legal acts public
units.text: Article 53. Making municipal legal acts public
units.label: Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Making municipal legal acts public
units.text: 1. The procedure for making municipal legal acts public, including agreements concluded between local self-government bodies, is established by the municipal charter and must enable citizens to acquaint themselves with them, except acts or individual provisions containing information whose dissemination is restricted by federal law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Making municipal legal acts public
units.text: 2. Making a municipal legal act public means:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Making municipal legal acts public
units.text: 1) official publication of the municipal legal act;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Making municipal legal acts public
units.text: 2) placing the municipal legal act in locations accessible to an unrestricted number of persons (premises of state bodies, local self-government bodies, state and municipal libraries, and other places open to visitors);
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Making municipal legal acts public
units.text: 3) posting the municipal legal act on the municipality’s official website on the Internet information and telecommunications network;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Making municipal legal acts public
units.text: 4) another means provided for by the municipal charter of enabling citizens to acquaint themselves with the municipal legal act, including an agreement concluded between local self-government bodies.
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Making municipal legal acts public
units.text: 3. Official publication of a municipal legal act, including an agreement concluded between local self-government bodies, means the first publication of its full text in a periodical print publication distributed in the relevant municipality, or its first posting in an online publication.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Making municipal legal acts public
units.text: 4. If a municipal legal act, including an agreement concluded between local self-government bodies, is officially published in an online publication, one or more Internet access points must be established in the municipality, in accordance with Federal Law of 09.02.2009 No. 8-ФЗ “On Ensuring Access to Information on the Activities of State Bodies and Local Self-Government Bodies”, in places accessible to an unrestricted number of persons (premises of state bodies, local self-government bodies, state and municipal libraries, and other places open to visitors), without requiring those persons to use additional technical equipment.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Making municipal legal acts public
units.text: 5. The municipal charter specifies the name of the periodical print publication and/or the name of the online publication, including the domain name of its website on the Internet information and telecommunications network and details of its registration as a mass media outlet, in which municipal legal acts, including agreements concluded between local self-government bodies, are officially published.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Making municipal legal acts public
units.text: 6. The list of periodical print publications and online publications, with the domain names of their websites on the Internet information and telecommunications network and details of their registration as mass media outlets, used to make municipal legal acts public (other than by official publication), including agreements concluded between local self-government bodies, is made generally known by publication of a legal act of the head of the municipality.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 53. Making municipal legal acts public
units.text: 7. Other documents and information required by this Federal Law to be made public are made public in accordance with the procedure provided for municipal legal acts.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 53

units.locator: Article 54. Revocation and suspension of municipal legal acts
units.text: Article 54. Revocation and suspension of municipal legal acts
units.label: Art. 54

units.locator: Article 54. Revocation and suspension of municipal legal acts
units.text: 1. Municipal legal acts may be revoked or suspended by the local self-government bodies or officials that adopted (issued) them; if those bodies or positions are abolished or their powers are changed, by the local self-government bodies or officials competent to adopt (issue) the corresponding act at the time of revocation or suspension; and also by a court. Insofar as an act regulates the exercise by local self-government bodies of individual state powers delegated to them by federal laws and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, it may be revoked or suspended by the authorized state authority of the Russian Federation (authorized state authority of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation).
units.label: Part 1 Art. 54

units.locator: Article 54. Revocation and suspension of municipal legal acts
units.text: 2. A non-regulatory municipal legal act must be suspended immediately by the local self-government body or official that adopted (issued) it upon receipt of a corresponding order from the Commissioner under the President of the Russian Federation for the Protection of Entrepreneurs’ Rights issued under the legislation of the Russian Federation on commissioners for the protection of entrepreneurs’ rights. Local self-government bodies or officials must inform the Commissioner of compliance with the order within three days; representative bodies of local self-government must do so no later than three days after adopting their decision.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 54

units.locator: Article 54. Revocation and suspension of municipal legal acts
units.text: 3. A court decision declaring a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation establishing a municipality’s status inoperative may not, before a new law of that constituent entity establishing the municipality’s status enters into force, serve as a ground for a court to declare inoperative, or for the revocation of, municipal legal acts adopted by that municipality before the court decision became legally effective.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 54

units.locator: Article 55. Federal register of municipal regulatory legal acts
units.text: Article 55. Federal register of municipal regulatory legal acts
units.label: Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Federal register of municipal regulatory legal acts
units.text: 1. Municipal regulatory legal acts, including decisions adopted at a local referendum or citizens’ assembly and formalized as legal acts, must be included in the constituent entity of the Russian Federation’s register of municipal regulatory legal acts. Its organization and maintenance are carried out by state authorities of the constituent entity in accordance with the procedure established by a law of that constituent entity.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Federal register of municipal regulatory legal acts
units.text: 2. The federal register of municipal regulatory legal acts consists of the registers of municipal regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Federal register of municipal regulatory legal acts
units.text: 3. The federal register of municipal regulatory legal acts is maintained by the authorized federal executive authority in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.label: Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 1. The municipal charter must determine:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 1) the name of the municipality;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 2) the list of powers of local self-government bodies to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 3) the forms, procedure and guarantees for the population’s participation in resolving matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 4) the structure and procedure for forming local self-government bodies;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 5) the names and powers of local self-government bodies and officials;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 6) the types of municipal legal acts and the procedure for their adoption (issue), public promulgation, including official publication, and entry into force;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 7) the types of liability of local self-government bodies and officials, grounds for that liability and the procedure for resolving the corresponding matters;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 8) the procedure for preparing and considering the draft local budget, approving and executing the local budget, controlling its execution, and preparing and approving the report on its execution in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 9) the procedure for amending and supplementing the municipal charter.
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 2. The municipal charter regulates other matters concerning the organization of local self-government in accordance with federal laws and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 3. The draft municipal charter and a draft municipal legal act amending or supplementing the charter must be officially published no later than 30 days before consideration of the adoption of the charter or amendments and additions to it, together with simultaneous official publication of the procedure established by the municipal representative body for considering proposals on the draft charter or draft municipal legal act and the procedure for citizens’ participation in its discussion.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 4. Official publication of the procedure for considering proposals on a draft municipal legal act amending or supplementing the municipal charter and of the procedure for citizens’ participation in its discussion is not required where amendments to the charter exactly reproduce provisions of the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal laws, or the constitution (charter) or laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in order to bring the charter into conformity with those regulatory legal acts.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 5. The municipal charter and a municipal legal act amending or supplementing it are adopted by the municipal representative body by a two-thirds majority of the established number of deputies.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 6. The municipal charter and a municipal legal act amending or supplementing it are subject to state registration with the territorial body of the federal executive authority authorized in the field of registration of municipal charters, in accordance with the procedure established by federal law.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 7. State registration of the municipal charter or a municipal legal act amending or supplementing it may be refused on the following grounds:
units.label: Part 7 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 1) the charter or amending municipal legal act conflicts with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal laws or the constitution (charter) and laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with them;
units.label: Point 1 Part 7 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Municipal charter
units.text: 2) violation of the procedure established by this Federal Law for adopting the charter or the municipal legal act amending or supplementing it;
units.label: Point 2 Part 7 Art. 56
